_doc: THE SHIPPED EXAMPLE, and the fixture tools/substitute_reconstruction.py --self-test runs over the committed town. It is NOT a reading: no source says this house existed, and nothing in data/ cites it. It is the shape a real one would arrive in — a house the research has just won, asking what its arrival would retire. Copy it, put your own reading in it, and run --dry-run over the copy.
name: An example brewery, offered to the tool and to nothing else
